summary.text: Julie Raque Adams is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 36 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Sarah Cole McIntosh.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Adams earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Mary's College and a master's degree from The George Washington University, and her professional experience includes owning Adams & Call, Inc.
She served in the Kentucky House of Representatives, District 32, from 2011 to 2015, and took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 1, 2015.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her on the Senate Banking and Insurance, Health and Welfare, Licensing and Occupations (chair), and State and Local Government committees.
